_notes: Gendered forms (V31 open item): every string addressing the student is now gender-neutral by construction, never with o/a slashes. Welcomes use the nominal 'Ti diamo il benvenuto' (register.done.title, mobile:signup.doneTitle, stageText.STUDENT_LIFE, appStatus.ENROLLED); 'Bentornato' became 'È bello rivederti'; 'Sei arrivato dall'app' became 'Arrivi dall'app'; 'Resti connesso' became 'L'accesso ... resta attivo'; 'Non ancora idoneo' became 'Requisiti non ancora soddisfatti'; 'il tuo consulente' became 'il team Hangyul' (as the English now says). Participles that remain agree with a thing (visto pronto, candidatura pronta, documento caricato), not with the person.

Staff-facing role nouns in mobile:agency.* / mobile:university.* / mobile:v3.agency|uni|reviews.* (studente, candidato, consulente, ammessi, iscritti) stay in the generic Italian form: they name a role in an operational list, they never address the user. University console strings use the formal plural 'voi' (vostra università, confermate), agency strings the operational 'tu'.

One term per concept: document review = 'verifica (dei documenti)' / verificare / verificato (team checks a document); essay review = 'revisione'; personal statement = 'lettera di motivazione'; study plan = 'progetto di studio' (fixes v17 'piano di studi' and the 'studioo' typo, avoids the Italian meaning of 'piano di studi' = course list and the collision with 'piano' = plan); mock interview = 'colloquio simulato' (was 'colloquio di prova'); visa document preparation = 'preparazione dei documenti per il visto' (never 'preparazione del visto'); matches = 'abbinamenti' everywhere (mobile:signup.quickGo said 'consigli'); dormitory = 'residenza universitaria'; settling in = 'inserimento'; help after arrival = 'assistenza dopo l'arrivo'.

Team name follows the English in each string: 'team Hangyul' for 'Hangyul team', 'team Hangyul Univ' for 'Hangyul Univ team'. Fixed where the Italian had the other one (home.team, messages.new.subtitle, documents.privacy.short, v15 priority_response, writing.status.FINAL_REVIEW, sponsor.subtitle).

Official names kept: apostille (feminine, 'l'apostille'), legalizzazione consolare, lettera di ammissione standard, visto D-2 / D-4, TOPIK, IELTS, TOEFL iBT, Toss Payments, GPA. App names (Hangyul Agency, Hangyul Univ, Hangyul University) are product names and stay in English.

Degree levels: Bachelor's = 'laurea di primo livello' (a Korean bachelor's is 4 years, so 'laurea triennale' in mobile:signup.degree.BACHELOR was misleading); Master's = 'laurea magistrale'; Doctorate = 'dottorato'; Associate = 'diploma post-secondario (2–3 anni)'. student:register.prior.level.BACHELOR ('una laurea triennale') was left as is because it asks what the Italian student has already finished. Owner may want one term there too.

'Intake' rendered as 'sessione di ingresso' (label) / 'sessioni' (all intakes) / 'semestre di inizio' (goals.term); 'Application season' stays 'periodo di candidatura'. Owner decision: if a single word is preferred everywhere, 'sessione'.

Native strings that interpolate a document name ({{label}}, {{item}}, {{path}}) are phrased so no article or gender agreement is needed ('Correggi {{label}} per …', 'Nuova copia di {{label}} …', 'Come ottenere: {{path}}'), because the inserted noun can be masculine or feminine.

Currency: 'Up to ₩{{amount}}M' rendered 'Fino a {{amount}} mln ₩'. Agency SLA wording: 'first-response promise' = 'impegno di prima risposta', 'review promise' = 'impegno di verifica'; no CRM vocabulary (caseload, pipeline) anywhere in student-facing copy; mobile:v3.uni.tab.pipeline = 'Panoramica' as the English does.
